cards.power: The Transparency-Armor. Paul loses heat and water at record pace due to paper-thin skin.
cards.lore: Lacks the Brown-Fat-Battery. Brain prone to IVH-the-Blood (fragile germinal matrix).
cards.gradeReason: Paul's tiny and see-through. You know who he is. Performance needs context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: NICU cartoon. Subject: Translucent mouse in incubator, paper-thin skin glowing. Mood: Fragile.

cards.power: The Anti-Collapse. Reduces surface tension. Prevents the Alveolar-Balloons from snapping shut.
cards.lore: Prevents Hyaline Membrane Disease. We must spray Liquid-Lung-Shield into the pipes.
cards.gradeReason: Coat those alveoli and don't let them pop. Classic G1 action, no setup needed.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Fluid hero art. Subject: Slippery frog coating alveolar bubbles with protective film. Mood: Protective.

cards.power: The Lung-Flooder. Fails to close, shunting blood from Aorta-Highway back into lungs.
cards.lore: Prostaglandins keep it open. Use Indo-the-Lock to shut the gate.
cards.gradeReason: Refuses to close. Floods the lungs. You ARE the failure to shut. Immediate.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Plumbing anatomy cartoon. Subject: Beaver refusing to plug blood-vessel dam, flooding lungs. Mood: Stubborn.

cards.power: The Gut-Eroder. Bacterial rot in the immature gut leading to Belly-Burst.
cards.lore: Triggered by Ischemia and Naive-Gut feeds. Requires Bowel-Rest and Antibiotic-Artillery.
cards.gradeReason: Pure gut-rot villain. No setup needed. You are the immature gut's nemesis.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Medical villain cartoon. Subject: Punk rat destroying immature gut wall. Mood: Menacing.

cards.power: The Constant-Open. Splints pipes open so the Knight doesn't fight for every breath.
cards.lore: Positive pressure prevents alveolar collapse, delaying the Vandal-Ventilator.
cards.gradeReason: Elephant splints airways open. Clear device role, needs table context to perform.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Heroic device character. Subject: Elephant blowing steady airstream into airway pipes. Mood: Steady.

cards.power: The Breathing-Reminder. Tells the Brain-Stem-Clock to keep ticking.
cards.lore: Preemies have an immature respiratory center. Caffeine increases CO2 sensitivity.
cards.gradeReason: You wake the brain stem up. Squirrel energy. Immediately playable at any table.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Energy character art. Subject: Squirrel injecting caffeine bolt into brain stem. Mood: Alert.

cards.power: The Sticky-Invasion. The Knight breathes his first Poop, causing a Chemical-Fire.
cards.lore: Causes air-trapping and persistent pulmonary hypertension (PPHN).
cards.gradeReason: First breath is poop. You ARE the sticky green chemical fire. No explanation needed.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Horror-comedy slime monster. Subject: Green slime blocking lung airway pipes. Mood: Disgusting.

cards.power: The Chronic-Stiff-Lung. The toll taken when the Vandal-Ventilator damages developing lungs.
cards.lore: The Alveolar-Balloons become scarred. The heavy price of early survival.
cards.gradeReason: Consequence of ventilation, not a performable character. Describes toll, doesn't invite action.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Scarred lung character. Subject: Scarred turtle living in cracked balloon habitat. Mood: Worn.

cards.power: The Basement-Flood. Fragile vessels burst, spilling blood into the brain's Water-Rooms.
cards.lore: Common in ELBW. Grade 3/4 leads to Hydrocephalus-the-Pressure.
cards.gradeReason: Basement flood metaphor lands hard. Staging grades 1-4 need context to play correctly.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Dark anatomy cartoon. Subject: Bat releasing blood flood into brain ventricles. Mood: Ominous.

cards.power: The Oxygen-Blackout. Occurs when the Oxygen-Line is cut during birth. Brain-Power-Failure.
cards.lore: needs Cool-the-Cap-Therapy to slow cellular decay.
cards.gradeReason: Needs Sunset Staging knowledge to play. Explains a system, not a singular role.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Clinical drama cartoon. Subject: Panda in oxygen deprivation with sunset-staged eyes. Mood: Critical.

cards.power: The Wiring-Damage. Destroys White-Matter-Cables, destroying future Motor-Mines.
cards.lore: Caused by pressure drops. The motor wiring literally melts away.
cards.gradeReason: White matter destruction is described, not performed. Medical consequence, not character.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Neural destruction art. Subject: Snake dissolving white matter cables in brain. Mood: Devastating.

cards.power: The Electrical-Glitch. Can be silent—just Lip-Smacking or Bicycling-Legs.
cards.lore: A surface symptom of underlying HIE or metabolic Stat errors.
cards.gradeReason: Bicycling legs and lip smacking are performable. Subtle presentation earns G2 not G1.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Electric charge cartoon. Subject: Monkey misfiring sparks with involuntary bicycling leg motion. Mood: Chaotic.

cards.power: The Skin-Stainer. The Liver-Factory is too slow to process red cell breakdown.
cards.lore: If Bili crosses the blood-brain barrier: Kernicterus (permanent damage).
cards.gradeReason: Skin staining is clear. You know you're yellow. Performance needs phototherapy context setup.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Jaundice creature art. Subject: Canary painting newborn skin yellow under bilirubin lamp. Mood: Warning.

cards.power: The Energy-Crash. Common in infants of diabetic mothers cut off from the High-Sugar-Stream.
cards.lore: Hyperinsulinism in utero leads to a massive crash when the cord is cut.
cards.gradeReason: The energy crash when cord is cut. Immediate. Diabetic mum context is self-evident.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Energy crash cartoon. Subject: Sloth crashing hard as umbilical cord is severed. Mood: Crashing.

cards.power: The Exposed-Gut. Intestines are born Outside the body, naked and angry.
cards.lore: Requires the Silo-Bag-Squeeze to slowly coax the organs back inside.
cards.gradeReason: You're naked gut. Vivid identity but Silo-Bag mechanics need table setup.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Surgical cartoon. Subject: Possum born with belly organs exposed, silo bag attached. Mood: Urgent.

cards.power: The Protected-Hernia. Outside the body, but protected inside a Safety-Bag.
cards.lore: High risk of associated genetic Gaps (Beckwith-Wiedemann).
cards.gradeReason: Protected hernia inside sac. Clear anatomy but genetic syndrome context required to perform.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Protected hernia character. Subject: Turtle with organs visible in transparent belly sac. Mood: Vulnerable.

cards.power: The Silent-Sepsis. Hides in the birth canal and ambushes the newborn.
cards.lore: Needs Intrapartum Antibiotic Prophylaxis (IAP) at weeks 35-37.
cards.gradeReason: Hides in birth canal, ambushes. Pure stealth villain. No setup needed. G1 gold.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Stealth villain cartoon. Subject: White moth lurking in birth canal ambushing newborn. Mood: Predatory.

cards.power: The Womb-Sabotage. Attacks the Knight before birth, causing Small-Size and Brain-Scars.
cards.lore: CMV is the leading cause of non-genetic hearing loss.
cards.gradeReason: Four-pathogen acronym needs explanation. Broad villain card without a singular playable character.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Womb sabotage art. Subject: Four distinct virus bugs attacking fetus together in utero. Mood: Silent threat.

cards.power: The Fungal-Clog. Makes feeding painful and skin raw.
cards.lore: Invades after Antibiotic-Artillery slaughters the Good-Guard-Bacteria.
cards.gradeReason: Fungal clog making feeding raw. Works at table with antibiotic-fallout context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Fungal villain art. Subject: White owl spreading yeast patches on exposed infant skin. Mood: Irritating.

cards.power: The Total-Body-Shutdown. Newborns don't get fevers; they get Quiet-and-Grey.
cards.lore: High meningitis risk. Deploy the Amp-and-Gent-Guards.
cards.gradeReason: Quiet-and-Grey instead of fever. That single line makes this the most legendary card in the deck.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Systemic shutdown art. Subject: Grey polar bear collapsing silently, no fever, no cry. Mood: Deadly quiet.

cards.power: The Artificial-Womb. Keeps the Knight Warm-and-Wet to conserve vital energy.
cards.lore: Prevents devastating Transepidermal Water Loss (TEWL).
cards.gradeReason: Warm and wet machine with personality. Charming but 'be an incubator' is abstract at table.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Warm tech character. Subject: Giraffe cradling ELBW preemie in humidity dome. Mood: Nurturing.

cards.power: The Direct-Highway. Immediate central access for High-Concentration-TPN and pressure.
cards.lore: Must verify tip placement on X-ray before use.
cards.gradeReason: Catheter with highway metaphor. Device, not character. Doesn't invite embodiment.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Medical access art. Subject: Golden snake threading precisely through umbilical vein. Mood: Precise.

cards.power: The Gentle-Inflation. Provides exact pressure without Vandalizing the delicate lungs.
cards.lore: Unlike manual self-inflating bags, the Neopuff guarantees consistent PEEP.
cards.gradeReason: Device card with device POWER. Needs practitioner context. Does not invite performance.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Steampunk fish cartoon. Subject: Pufferfish delivering controlled T-piece pressure to fragile lungs. Mood: Controlled.

cards.power: The Yellow-Melter. Physically transforms Bili-the-Yellow into water-soluble Lumirublin.
cards.lore: Protect the Knight's eyes from the Blue-Blaster.
cards.gradeReason: Yellow-Melter is a great name. Still a device. Needs Bili context. Solid G2.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Transformation art. Subject: Blue light dragon converting yellow bilirubin crystals to clear. Mood: Transformative.

cards.power: The Blood-Blocker. Prevents Vitamin K Deficiency Bleeding (VKDB).
cards.lore: Newborns possess zero K-Storage. Without it, they bleed into the brain.
cards.gradeReason: Blood-Blocker who prevents brain bleed. Clear preventive role. Standard prophylaxis card.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Armored protector. Subject: Armadillo blocking brain bleeding with vitamin K shield. Mood: Preventive.

cards.power: The Blindness-Barrier. The first defense against Gonorrheal conjunctivitis.
cards.lore: A mandatory Delivery Room buff applied to every Knight.
cards.gradeReason: Mandatory Delivery Room buff for every Knight. Routine guardian earns solid G2.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Eye protection art. Subject: Bee applying erythromycin ointment across every newborn's eyes. Mood: Routine guardian.

cards.power: The Life-Line-Extension. Keeps Duct-the-Persistent OPEN in cyanotic heart defects.
cards.lore: Buys time and keeps the baby alive until the Surgical-Team arrives.
cards.gradeReason: Keeps ductus open for cyanotic hearts. Counter-intuitive action requires cardiac context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Lifeline character. Subject: Badger holding ductus arteriosus open as surgical team races in. Mood: Urgent hold.

cards.power: The Gate-Closer. Forces the Duct to snap shut, halting the Lung-Flood.
cards.lore: Also heavily used to prevent IVH in extremely premature babies.
cards.gradeReason: Gate-Closer forces the duct shut. Immediately playable against Duct-the-Persistent. Perfect G1.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Gate-closing art. Subject: Rhino slamming ductus arteriosus shut with iron gate. Mood: Decisive.

cards.power: The Valve-Reversal. Lung-pipes clamp shut, forcing blood to completely skip the lungs.
cards.lore: Devastating high resistance. Requires Nitric-the-Gas to relax the iron grip.
cards.gradeReason: Valve reversal forces blood past lungs. Clear villain logic, needs physiology context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Blood reversal art. Subject: Ram clamping lung pipes shut, blood reversing direction entirely. Mood: Catastrophic.

cards.power: The Pipe-Opener. Selectively relaxes the pipes only in the lungs, not the systemic host.
cards.lore: Targeted cGMP-activation. The ultimate weapon against PPHN.
cards.gradeReason: Pipe-Opener only in the lungs. Surgical precision. Pair with PPHN and immediately understood.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Selective pipe art. Subject: Blue dragon selectively relaxing only lung pipes, others untouched. Mood: Precision.

cards.power: The Vessel-Sensitizer. Primes the heart and pipes to finally hear adrenaline signals.
cards.lore: Deployed when the baby's own Adrenal Factory is too immature to mount a stress response.
cards.gradeReason: Vessel-Sensitizer primes heart to respond. Context needed: what is adrenal immaturity?
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Steroid sensitizer art. Subject: Meerkat priming adrenal signals with satellite dish alert. Mood: Awakening.

cards.power: The Pump-Beast. Mechanically drives blood pressure up when the Micro-heart fails.
cards.lore: The first-line pressor deployed in many NICUs to fight Hypotension-the-Hollow.
cards.gradeReason: Pump-Beast drives blood pressure. Name plus POWER leave no room for doubt. Pure G1.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Inotrope power art. Subject: Bull smashing blood pressure gauge upward with both fists. Mood: Forceful.

cards.power: The Space-Occupier. The gut invades the chest, brutally squashing the Lung-Balloons.
cards.lore: Usually left-sided (Bochdalek). Lung hypoplasia is the true killer, not the hernia itself.
cards.gradeReason: Gut invades chest and squashes lungs. Space-Occupier is immediately playable villain action.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Gut invasion anatomy. Subject: Snake gut squeezing through diaphragm hole squashing lung balloons. Mood: Invasion.

cards.power: The Pipe-Mixer. The Food-Pipe and Wind-Pipe are dangerously soldered together.
cards.lore: Associated with VACTERL. Food dumps to lungs, air dumps to stomach.
cards.gradeReason: Food goes to wind, air goes to gut. Pipe-Mixer is instantly performable chaos.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Pipe wiring error. Subject: Griffin with food-pipe and air-pipe wrongly soldered together. Mood: Wrong circuit.

cards.power: The Nose-Block. Newborns are obligate nose breathers. Blocked nose = choking until crying.
cards.lore: Crying forces open the Mouth-Gate, bypassing the blocked nose temporarily.
cards.gradeReason: Nose blocked, cries to breathe. Mechanics clear once obligate-nose-breathing rule is established.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Obligate breather art. Subject: Bulldog with blocked nose choking until crying opens mouth gate. Mood: Emergency.

cards.power: The Nerve-Gap. A segment of colon is missing Neural-Drivers, remaining completely Static.
cards.lore: Aganglionic segment causes everything upstream to balloon into a Mega-Colon.
cards.gradeReason: Missing Neural-Drivers leaving colon frozen. Static metaphor earns G2 with gut context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Static gut art. Subject: Possum with one frozen colon segment, megacolon ballooning upstream. Mood: Static.

cards.power: The Immune-Primer. Paints the Gut-Gate with antibodies.
cards.lore: The First-Vaccine. The ultimate defense against Necro-the-Entero.
cards.gradeReason: Paints the Gut-Gate with antibodies. The most poetic G1 in the deck. Nothing more needed.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Immune gold art. Subject: Bee queen pouring golden antibodies directly onto gut gate. Mood: Protective gold.

cards.power: The Growth-Boost. Mimics the Placental-Feed with hyper-dense protein and calcium.
cards.lore: Preemies miss the 3rd-trimester Nutrient-Dump and require massive extra caloric supply.
cards.gradeReason: Nutrient supplement for preemies. Functional not performative. Describes a product, not a character.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Supplement character. Subject: Bear chef adding dense protein powder to breast milk bottle. Mood: Fortifying.

cards.power: The Bypass-Fuel. When the gut is offline, the blood directly carries the food.
cards.lore: Pure chemical fuel essential for building the brain and bones of ELBW knights.
cards.gradeReason: IV bypass nutrition. Bypass-Fuel describes mechanism, not a performable role at table.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: IV bypass art. Subject: Spider weaving nutrient web directly into a blood vessel. Mood: Bypass.

cards.power: The Skeleton-Sag. Without womb-level calcium, the bones turn to soft rubber.
cards.lore: Osteopenia of Prematurity. Requires aggressive high-dose mineral supplementation.
cards.gradeReason: Condition not character. Naming clash with card 52 creates urgent table confusion.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Soft bone character. Subject: Flamingo with rubbery bending bones, calcium completely depleted. Mood: Fragile.

cards.power: The Chemical-Freeze. Slows metabolic time to halt Excitotoxicity in the brain.
cards.lore: Must initiate within 6 hours of birth to save the Knight's brain.
cards.gradeReason: Chemical-Freeze is evocative but it's a treatment device with a 6-hour clock. Not character.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Cooling therapy art. Subject: Polar bear lowering brain temperature cap within critical 6-hour window. Mood: Race.

cards.power: The Vessel-Burner. Destroys Wild Vessels before they can peel the retina off.
cards.lore: A brutal trade: sacrifices peripheral vision to guarantee central vision.
cards.gradeReason: Vessel-Burner destroying wild vessels before retina detaches. Vivid surgical trade-off. G1 action.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Retinal surgery art. Subject: Praying mantis laser-burning wild eye vessels before retinal peel. Mood: Surgical sacrifice.

cards.power: The Pressure-Release. Manually vents blood-stained fluid from the brain to the belly.
cards.lore: The mechanical fix when Hydrocephalus forces the skull to expand too fast.
cards.gradeReason: Pressure-Release vents brain fluid. Procedural card, but shunt mechanics are clear enough.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Neurosurgery cartoon. Subject: Woodpecker plumber venting brain fluid down into abdominal drain. Mood: Relief.

cards.power: The Sensory-Shield. Dark rooms and swaddling defeat the chaotic Withdrawal-Riot.
cards.lore: The first-line behavioral defense to reduce Morphine reliance in drug-exposed babies.
cards.gradeReason: Dark rooms defeat Withdrawal-Riot. Sensory-Shield is clear; behavioral performance needs context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Withdrawal soothing art. Subject: Koala in dark swaddle, quietly defeating chaotic withdrawal riot. Mood: Calm.

cards.power: The Transition-Judge. Scores whether the Knight is winning the brutal fight to breathe air.
cards.lore: Heart rate is the single most heavily weighted Stat in the score.
cards.gradeReason: Transition-Judge scoring the birth fight. Clear role, needs Apgar scoring knowledge.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Assessment owl art. Subject: Owl scoring newborn in ledger, heart rate as top weighted stat. Mood: Judging.

cards.power: The Shunt-Detector. A numerical gap proves blood is skipping the lungs via the Duct.
cards.lore: The universal Gold-Standard screen for critical congenital heart defects.
cards.gradeReason: Shunt-Detector with numerical gap. Diagnostic tool as character. Screening role is clear.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Pulse ox chameleon art. Subject: Chameleon showing color gap between right hand and left foot. Mood: Detection.

cards.power: The Vision-Guard. If the reflex bounces back white, Retino-the-White-Reflex is hiding inside.
cards.lore: The simplest, fastest check that universally saves eyes and lives.
cards.gradeReason: Vision-Guard catching white reflex intruder. Sentry name gives clear protective role.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Eye exam spotlight art. Subject: Lemur holding ophthalmoscope catching white reflex intruder. Mood: Vigilant.

cards.power: The Hidden-Glitches-Finder. Sweeps the blood for metabolic errors before symptoms hit.
cards.lore: Executed precisely at 24-48 hours of life to prevent permanent brain damage.
cards.gradeReason: Hidden-Glitches-Finder sweeps metabolic errors. Immediately clear investigative role. G1.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Blood spot scroll art. Subject: Turtle unrolling metabolic disease scroll from blood spot sample. Mood: Discovery.

cards.power: The Sludge-Flow. Blood becomes so dense it physically jams the Micro-Pipes, triggering seizures or NEC.
cards.lore: A classic trap for Small-for-Gestational-Age (SGA) Knights.
cards.gradeReason: Sludge-Flow jams the Micro-Pipes. Dense blood villain is immediately visceral and clear.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Thick blood villain art. Subject: Hippo in blood vessel too thick to flow, jamming pipes. Mood: Sludging.

cards.power: The Fluid-Overload. The body entirely loses fluid regulation, drowning in its own water.
cards.lore: Immune (Rh) or Non-immune (Heart/Parvo) triggers. Extremely high mortality.
cards.gradeReason: Drowning in its own water. Body loses all fluid regulation. Total disaster. Immediately understood.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Fluid overload art. Subject: Pufferfish drowning helplessly in its own swollen body fluid. Mood: Drowning.

cards.power: The Oxygen-Carrier Shortage. The Marrow-Factory goes on strike, halting red cell production.
cards.lore: Immature kidneys simply refuse to synthesize enough EPO until the baby ages.
cards.gradeReason: Marrow-Factory on strike is a great image. Name itself is too clinical. G2.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Marrow strike art. Subject: Donkey cart with empty red cell load, EPO factory on strike. Mood: Depletion.

cards.power: The Fragile-Frame. Depleted calcium/phosphorus causes bones to literally snap during routine Nappy-Changes.
cards.lore: The devastating result of missing the massive 3rd-trimester placental calcium dump.
cards.gradeReason: Bones snap during Nappy-Changes is vivid. That image rescues an otherwise clinical card.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Bone snap art. Subject: Starfish with brittle snapping bones during routine nappy change. Mood: Fragility.

verdict: The Micro-Battalion arrives fully armed: 52 characters who make NICU pathophysiology impossible to forget. Sepsis-the-Systemic-Rot alone earns the price of admission — 'Newborns don't get fevers; they get Quiet-and-Grey' belongs on every NICU wall. Weakness: the device cluster (UVC, Neopuff, TPN, HMF) feels like inventory rather than cast — they describe what they do without making you want to be them. Two Osteo cards (40 and 52) will cause table confusion mid-round. Table-ready: Yes.
blurb: The NICU made playable: 52 unforgettable characters spanning prematurity, infection, surgery, and neonatal crisis. Essential for med students, NICU nurses, and anyone who needs to remember this stuff for life.

marketingText:
MedKayfab: NEONATAL MEDICINE – The Micro-Battalion (Medical Mnemonics Cut & Play Comic)

52 illustrated medical mnemonic cards to master the physiology of prematurity, the sepsis that arrives without a fever, and the surgical emergencies a baby is born already carrying.

Forget the fever. There will not be one. Almost everything you learned reading a sick adult quietly fails you in this room, and the newborn does not warn you it has changed the rules. Infection does not spike a temperature here; it goes Quiet-and-Grey, the crying stops, the fight stops, and by the time a number on the monitor finally agrees with you the window has mostly closed. The baby breathes through its nose only, until a blocked one chokes it silent. It bleeds heat and water through skin you can nearly read a newspaper through. Its brain vessels are built to burst and its lungs are built to stick shut. This is not adult medicine in a smaller body. It is a different physiology wearing the same shape, and it punishes anyone who assumes the old rules carried over.

MedKayfab Neonatal Medicine turns that physiology into 52 characters, each with a face, a tell, and a clock. You cannot memorize your way to a Quiet-and-Grey baby. You have to recognize one before it goes quiet, and these cards drill that recognition until it becomes a face you can pick out of the incubator at three in the morning.

YOU'LL GET
- 52 illustrated MedKayfab cards (15pp, 4 cards/page), with a closing KayfaBINGO! synthesis page that folds the whole battalion back into quest scenarios
- Full MedKayfab Freestyle rules (Quest Die mechanics)
- S-Tier characters like Sepsis-the-Systemic-Rot, Colostrum-the-Gold, and GBS-the-Ghost
- Free lifetime updates as guidelines evolve
- CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 licence, print, share, and adapt freely
- PDF optimized for home printing (A4 / Letter)

What's in the deck
Sepsis-the-Systemic-Rot is the grey bear who carries the one line that belongs on every NICU wall: newborns do not get fevers, they get quiet and grey. Colostrum-the-Gold is the first vaccine, painting the gut gate with antibodies before Necro-the-Entero can rot the immature bowel from the inside. GBS-the-Ghost lurks in the birth canal and ambushes the baby on the way out, which is exactly why it earns an antibiotic screen at weeks 35 to 37. TEF-the-Miswire is the wiring error you cannot unsee once it has a face: food pipe and windpipe soldered together, so food dumps into the lungs and air dumps into the stomach. The deck also teaches in pairs, so Duct-the-Persistent floods the lungs and Indo-the-Lock slams the gate shut, and learning one drags the other along with it.

How it works
Every card is a cognitive anchor: the Character (the mnemonic), the Visual (the scene), the Stat Block, the Lore (the clinical story), and the Quest (the challenge). The Mechanism Flash mode is the test that matters: explain the mechanism in one sentence without looking, or the patient on the Stage does not make it. Neonatology rewards this format because so much of the field is counter play. The Quest often asks you to name the right counter before the clock runs out, the lock for the duct, the gas for the pressure, the gold for the gut.

Honest cognitive load
This one is for med students on their paediatrics and neonatology rotations, NICU and delivery-room nurses, midwives, and anyone sitting paediatric boards. It assumes you already hold the basic cardiorespiratory and fluid physiology, because the whole point here is watching the newborn invert all of it. It pairs naturally with Pediatrics for the growing-child arc that picks up where this deck ends, with Obstetrics & Gynaecology for the delivery-room handover where GBS, meconium, and the Apgar score live, and with Emergency Medicine for the resuscitation reflexes the first minutes demand.

ABOUT MEDKAYFAB
MedKayfab is a narrative medical learning card game, 50 decks covering the full medical curriculum. Every card encodes a clinical mechanism as a character with a personality, a story, and a reasoning challenge. Built by a physician. Assembled with AI tools. Manually revised. Honest about its limitations. Free to use, share, and adapt under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

PAY WHAT YOU WANT
This deck is Pay What You Want, including free.
If you find it useful: a fair price is €5. If you are a student on a budget: enter €0. No questions asked. If you want to support more decks: anything above fair price is appreciated.
CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, share freely, attribute honestly, never resell.

DISCLAIMER
MedKayfab is a learning companion, not a clinical reference. Content was created by a physician and reviewed to the best of our knowledge, but medicine evolves, guidelines change, and some mechanisms in here will be simplified or wrong. Always verify against current primary sources and clinical guidelines before applying anything to patient care. The Blödsinn! is the vehicle. The science is serious.

Stay fluffy. — Doc FrizzleBob
